# SchemaForge

> An open-source, intelligent, multi-engine schema design and management tool, where a coding agent and an architect work on the same live design through MCP, and nothing lands unchecked: a schema designed from scratch, reverse-engineered from a database, converted from one engine to another, its intelligence stored with it. Every database is an engine plugin, and the engines come in families: two full-feature engines, engine_mysql and engine_postgresql, each built once across every version of its database, and every managed service, distribution or compatible database falls into its family as a subset of it (MySQL: Percona Server, Amazon RDS, Cloud SQL, Amazon Aurora, TiDB; PostgreSQL: Amazon RDS, Cloud SQL, Amazon Aurora, AlloyDB, Spanner, CockroachDB), declared as facts and checked, not built again: what looks like a dozen engines is two, by the design of the schema. At the centre stands the database SchemaForge keeps its work in: one PostgreSQL database, schema_forge, in the PostgreSQL 18 bundled with the app, every design rows of it under its UUIDv7, holding the cortex every engine shares and each engine's own tables, each owner in its own namespace, designed before any of it is built and locked so every build falls into it.

Start with the brief for coding agents: https://k8nstantin.github.io/schema-forge/agents.xml. The files below are the authority.

## Spec

- [specs/root.xml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/main/specs/root.xml): identity and purpose, authority (which files decide), method (how every task is built), the sequence of tasks and every decision with its date
- [specs/rules.xml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/main/specs/rules.xml): every rule, where it comes from, and what catches a breach
- [o5 · engine trait: the Engine trait and registry; engine_mysql in Rust, designed from MySQL's catalog, proven by round trips on seven servers; import and write](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/main/specs/tasks/SF-156-engine-mysql.xml)

## Authority

- [schema/cortex/](https://github.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/tree/main/schema/cortex): every table of the namespace cortex, in the one database schema_forge, in owner.toml's order: the plugs (plugins, plugin_tables, engines, engine_versions, engine_flavors, object_kinds, schema_migrations), designs and their history (designs, branches, turns, operations, row_changes, locked_versions), and the model every engine shares (namespaces, objects, columns, indexes, index_parts, constraints, constraint_columns, dependencies); one CREATE TABLE statement per file, named after its table, every column commented on its line (the installer makes those its comments in the database); functions/, the log's writer, the turn bell, the checks every engine shares, plugging in, and undo
- [engines/<engine>/schema/](https://github.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/tree/main/engines): an engine plugin's own tables, in the namespace engine_<engine> (engine_mysql.tables), each a plug: its design, UNIQUE (design, id), and the foreign key to the cortex row it extends; functions/, its own checks (engine_mysql.check_flavor)
- [engines/<engine>/seeds/](https://github.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/tree/main/engines): what an engine plugin declares to the cortex when it is plugged in: the engine, its versions, its flavors with what each refuses and the documentation each fact is from, its kinds of object with their versions and tables, and its tables as plugs
- [schema/dump/schema_forge.sql](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/main/schema/dump/schema_forge.sql): the whole database as CI builds and tests it, every grant and policy among it: what the installer must install, exactly (tools/local/lock.py)
- [docs/owner-template/](https://github.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/tree/main/docs/owner-template): the shape of every owner's folder (an engine's, a feature's, and the cortex's alike): its owner.toml card, the shapes of a table, its seeds/ and migrations/, a rename in two versions
- [engines/mysql/](https://github.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/tree/main/engines/mysql): engine_mysql: its reader (a live server into the model), rows module (the model as the cortex's and engine_mysql's rows, and back) and writer (the model as SQL)
- [tools/](https://github.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/tree/main/tools): every check, each a tool: tools/check.py, tools/cortex/all.py, tools/mysql/all.py, tools/local/install.py and its test, tools/local/lock.py, tools/objectives.py
- [docs/engines.xml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/main/docs/engines.xml): the earlier plugin design; where it and decision service-plugins differ, the decision decides
- [docs/connections.xml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/k8nstantin/schema-forge/main/docs/connections.xml): connections: what an engine declares, profiles without secrets, the five test steps
